ABOUT COLUMN

For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand — builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve.


At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. This means a safer, more transparent, and less costly banking supply chain. Come build with us!



The opportunity:
We're a lean, experienced engineering team, and we're hiring our first Forward Deployed Engineer. You'll define what this role looks like at Column.

As an FDE, you'll work with customers to understand their problems in depth and help them build new products on Column's APIs. What you learn in the field will feed directly into how our engineering team improves the platform.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll write code, debug payment flows and design integrations, and you'll spend a lot of time on-site with customers. You'll get deep exposure to the full banking stack, from our APIs down to the Federal Reserve.

This role is based in our Presidio office in San Francisco, with frequent travel to customer sites in the US and abroad. You will report directly to William, the CEO.


Read more about Life @ Column and our hiring process here https://www.notion.so/Hiring-at-Column-b8d9b2628317491989d4713091b6bb68?pvs=21. 🚀



What you'll do:

 - Work directly with our partner’s engineering teams to design, build and launch products with Column's state-of-the-art banking stack

 - Act as the technical owner for strategic customers from onboarding to launch, unblocking them on architecture, ledgering, reconciliation and edge cases in money movement

 - Write production-quality code, that speeds up integrations and grows into reusable product

 - Turn patterns from the field into product and platform improvements, working closely with engineering to shape our APIs, docs and developer experience

 - Advise customers on how to build safe, compliant and resilient financial products in a regulated environment

 - Represent Column in conversations with customer executives and engineering leaders, and build trusted, long-term relationships

What we're looking for:

 - Need to be fluent in either Spanish, French or Russian.

 - Strong engineering fundamentals, ideally with experience in backend systems, APIs or infrastructure

 - Product thinking: you look past the immediate ask to the underlying problem and the best solution, for the customer and for Column

 - Excellent interpersonal and communication skills. You can explain complex systems clearly to an engineer or an executive

 - Executive presence and the confidence to lead high-stakes customer conversations

 - Strong project management skills. You can run several customer engagements at once and keep each one moving

 - A self-starter mindset. You're comfortable with ambiguity and with building process where none exists yet

 - Experience with payments, banking or financial infrastructure is a plus


WHAT YOU’LL GET FROM US:

 - 🏥 Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans, including options that are 100% covered by Column for you and 100% covered for your dependents!

 - 🐣 Comprehensive family planning and fertility benefits via partnership with Carrot, including reimbursement of up to $20,000 in qualified expenses

 - 🏡 Up to $2,000 (post-tax) monthly rent subsidy for employees living within 2 miles of Column’s office

 - 💳 FSA and HSA account options to enable use of pre-tax money for medical and dependent care expenses

 - 👶 100% paid parental leave, including 16 weeks for birth mothers, 12 weeks for primary caregivers, and 8 weeks for secondary caregivers

 - 😇 Up to $4,500 in annual reimbursements for backup childcare

 - 🍽️ Catered lunches and dinners for SF employees

 - 🚆 Commuter benefits, including paid transportation to-and-from the office

 - 🎉 Regular team building events, including annual offsite




PAY TRANSPARENCY:

Compensation packages at Column include base salary, equity, and benefits. New hire offers are made based on a candidate's experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.

ABOUT CYVL

The best infrastructure is invisible. You only notice it when it fails. For decades, the people responsible for our roads, bridges and sidewalks have been asked to manage the physical world with tools that can't see it.

Cyvl is the Physical AI company changing that. We build purpose-built sensors, computer vision and AI that turn every drive into current data: what exists, where it is and what condition it's in. 500+ cities and towns use our Infrastructure Intelligence Platform to direct the work and fix problems before they fail. 1 in 30 Americans drive on roads managed with Cyvl data.

The proof isn't a dashboard. It's a smoother commute, a safer walk to school and public dollars going where they matter most. We're a fast-moving team in Boston building hardware, software and AI for the real world. If you believe technology's highest calling is public good, come build with us.




THE ROLE

Cyvl has one of the largest proprietary datasets of US infrastructure: LiDAR and imagery from hundreds of cities. As an AI Engineer, you'll turn that data into intelligence, from computer vision models that detect and assess assets to LLM-powered agents and tools that let customers and partners ask questions of the physical world. You'll work from prototype to production, shipping models and AI features customers use every day. This role is based in Somerville, MA, or remote from San Francisco, CA.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and improve computer vision and 3D perception models that detect, classify, and assess infrastructure (pavement, signs, sidewalks, trees) from LiDAR and imagery.

 - Build LLM-powered products: agentic workflows, our MCP server, and AI copilots that put Cyvl data to work inside customer tools.

 - Own models from data and training through evaluation, deployment, and monitoring in production.

 - Design evaluation sets and metrics that tie model performance to what customers actually need.

 - Stay close to the state of the art and bring the right new tools into our products and our own workflows.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - 3+ years building and shipping ML or AI systems in production

 - Strong Python and a modern deep learning framework (PyTorch preferred)

 - Hands-on experience with computer vision, 3D perception, or LLM applications (RAG, tool use, agents, evals)

 - Solid software engineering fundamentals: testing, code review, and cloud deployment

 - Ability to go from an ambiguous problem to a working prototype quickly, then make it production-grade




NICE TO HAVE

 - Point cloud or multimodal work (LiDAR and imagery fusion)

 - Model Context Protocol (MCP), foundation model APIs, or agent frameworks

 - Geospatial or remote sensing background

 - MLOps: model serving, GPU infrastructure, experiment tracking

 - Advanced degree in CS, ML, robotics, or a related field, or equivalent experience




WHY CYVL

Hard tech. Real streets. Your name on it.

 - Hard problems in the real world. You build end-to-end: our own hardware, software and AI, with work that shows up on the street in the real world.

 - Ownership that compounds. You own outcomes, not tasks. You work directly with customers and across our team, and you'll own more, sooner, than almost anywhere else.

 - Intense, with heart. We're building a category, so it's not a place to coast. We also take care of each other, have genuine fun together, and believe in what we are doing.




WHAT WE ASK

 - Cross lanes. "Not my job" doesn't exist here.

 - Own without a playbook. The plan is still being written, often by you.

 - Try, miss, try again. We make big bets. Some won't land, and we learn fast.

 - Be in the room. We're on-site in Somerville about 90% of the time. If you're based in San Francisco, this role is remote, and you'll be with the team in Somerville for the moments that matter like onboarding, kick-offs, and milestones.

We're a startup building a category. If that sounds like the draw, not the risk, we'd love to talk.




BENEFITS

 - Equity. You'll own a piece of what you're building.

 - Health, dental, and vision. Cyvl covers most of the premium for you and your family.

 - 401k with a real match, vested day one. Your money is yours from the start.

 - Generous PTO & Paid Parental leave. Doing hard work well includes stepping away from it.

 - Learning stipend. Spend it on whatever makes you sharper.

 - Paid to live close. A monthly bonus for living near our Boston office.

 - Team events. Time together in Boston with a team you’ll love working with.




OUR VALUES

 - Real: Authentic and transparent. Focused on solving real problems with simple, effective solutions.

 - All Out: Bold, driven, and committed to delivering results that matter.

 - Accelerating: Always learning, growing, and moving with intention.

 - Reliable: We follow through and deliver at a consistently high bar.

 - Empowering: We lift each other up and help governments build infrastructure they can be proud of.
